en.headline: Cheung sues Hui for 10.1 billion dollars in High Court
en.dek: A writ seen by local media says Francis Cheung claims Xu Jiayin confirmed an unpaid balance in November 2022 and has not repaid it.
body: Francis Cheung Song-kio has filed a High Court claim against China Evergrande founder Xu Jiayin for 10.1 billion dollars, plus interest and costs, local media reported on Thursday.

According to a writ obtained by HK01, and also reported by RTHK, Cheung says the two men made a series of oral agreements between May 2010 and October 2020. He claims he advanced 29 billion dollars at Xu's request, and that Xu repaid 18.65 billion dollars between 2014 and 2020.

The statement of claim says Xu confirmed in writing in November 2022 that 10.1 billion dollars remained outstanding as of 15 November 2022, and that he has not repaid that balance, the report said. It described the two men as friends at the material times.

The filing follows a separate High Court action brought last week in Xu's name by Evergrande's liquidators, seeking up to 18.65 billion dollars from Cheung over unpaid loans, HK01 reported. Neither claim has been tested in court.

zh.headline: 張松橋入稟高院追討許家印101億元
zh.dek: 本地傳媒引述入稟狀指，許家印2022年11月書面確認尚欠101億元，惟未有償還。
body: 本地傳媒星期四報道，張松橋已入稟高等法院，向中國恒大創辦人許家印申索101億元，以及相關利息和訟費。
《香港01》取得的入稟狀，香港電台亦有報道。狀書指兩人於2010年5月至2020年10月訂立多項口頭協議，張松橋應許家印要求墊付290億元，許家印在2014至2020年償還其中186.5億元。
報道引述申索陳述書指，許家印於2022年11月書面確認，截至2022年11月15日仍欠101億元，但其後未有償還。陳述書稱，在關鍵時間兩人為朋友關係。
《香港01》另報道，恒大清盤人上星期以許家印名義在高院興訟，向張松橋追討未償還貸款，金額高至186.5億元。兩宗申索仍有待法庭審理。
